scripts.dev: lsof -i :5173 | grep LISTEN && kill -9 $(lsof -t -i :5173) || true && vite dev
scripts.build:production: cp svelte.config.production.js svelte.config.js && NODE_ENV=production vite build && cp svelte.config.js svelte.config.production.js
scripts.db:migrate: for file in ../database-migrations/*.sql; do echo "Running migration: $file"; mysql -u root -p < "$file"; done
scripts.db:reset: mysql -u root -p -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS personal_tutor_ai; CREATE DATABASE personal_tutor_ai; USE personal_tutor_ai;" && npm run db:setup
